name: Write
source: lane DD: 0x4b2fb0 (cIGZSerializable slot)

name: Read
source: lane DD: 0x4b0980

name: GetGZCLSID
source: lane DD: 0x4af2d0 returns 0xabcb5da4

name: Initialize
source: lane DD: 0x4afc30: types, cell size, SetSize(nbhd 52, 53), heights 45.0, flags 0, cheat + messages; 1

name: Shutdown
source: lane DD: 0x4b2640: RemoveNotification, clears rows/paint/face rows, releases both arrays; 1

name: SetHeightAt
source: lane DD: 0x4b2540 (ret 0x10): in vertex range and changed: store, notify -> SendTerrainMessage(0x6c09445c, x, y, 0)

name: ResampleGrid
source: lane DD: 0x4b1fb0: linear interpolation between samples every step vertices, rows then columns, SetHeightAt(.., 0)

name: GetInterpolatedHeight
source: lane DD: 0x4af9e0: 0 outside (slot 43); cell from floor(x * invCellSize) clamped, triangle interpolation

name: GetHeightRange
source: lane DD: 0x4af650: FLT_MAX/-FLT_MAX, then min/max of GetHeightAt over the vertex rect when valid

name: WorldToVertex
source: lane DD: 0x4ae780: (int)(x / worldSizeX * (float)vertsX)

name: GetVertexNormal
source: lane DD: 0x4af700: normals[y * vertsX + x] or the global default vector 0x10131e0

name: GetWaterDepthAt
source: lane DD: 0x4b2d50: waterLevel - GetHeightAt(x, y)

name: UpdateNormals
source: lane DD: 0x4b29c0: force or !mNormalsValid -> RecomputeNormals(whole grid)

name: RebuildDerivedMaps
source: lane DD: 0x4b2a00: normals, shore distance rows, lot distance, paint weights (normalised to 250), per-type weight maps

name: Save
source: lane DD: 0x4b1e40: persist SaveResource(slot 40(), 0), FindSegment(GetKey, 0x656b8f0c) then segment Flush; and of both

name: SetTerrainType
source: lane DD: 0x4b24b0: same name (cIGZString slot 11, 0) -> 1; else find in the 0x828-byte type entries, store, post 0xac3a02d9; 0 if unknown

name: GetTerrainTypeName
source: lane DD: 0x4afbf0: 0 without a type, else out slot 17 (entry)

name: SetVertexFlag
source: lane DD: 0x4b25a0: vertex {x, y, layer}; bit (layer ? 2 : 1); on change message 0x2bfb06fa (set) / 0x0bfb0707 (clear), sent or posted

name: GetVertexFlag
source: lane DD: 0x4b00e0: no bounds check

name: GetVertexTerrainTypes
source: lane DD: 0x4af870: clear vector<u8>, add each non-zero layer type once (no bounds check)

name: GetRectTerrainTypes
source: lane DD: 0x4af8f0 (ret 8, not read in full): same helpers as slot 25

name: GetVertexTypeWeight
source: lane DD: 0x4af7b0: low byte of the weight of that layer, 0 if absent or outside

name: GetRectTypeWeights
source: lane DD: 0x4af2e0 (not read in full): sums layer weights per type id (temp vector<float> of maxTypeId + 1)

name: GetTypeWeightMap
source: lane DD: 0x4af760: static table: node + 0x7c (byte map data) or null

name: GetTerrainTypeIds
source: lane DD: 0x4af580: clear vector<u8>, push every key of the static type table in list order

name: GetTypeName
source: lane DD: 0x4af810: out slot 17 (node + 0x10)

name: GetTypeAltName
source: lane DD: 0x4af5f0: out slot 16 (node + 0x34)

name: GetTypeFlag
source: lane DD: 0x4b04a0: byte at node + 0x30, 0 if absent

name: GetMaxTypeId
source: lane DD: 0x4b0290: global byte 0x10daad5

name: SlopeRect
source: lane DD: 0x4b2700 (ret 0x14, not read in full): degrees * 3.14 / 180, tan

name: ImportHeights
source: lane DD: 0x4b02a0 (not read in full): source slot 4 -> heights (slot 16) and size (slot 5), count must be (w+1)(h+1)

name: IsVertexUnderWater
source: lane DD: 0x4b0110: height < waterLevel

name: IsCellUnderWater
source: lane DD: 0x4b0030: all four corners < waterLevel (x < width, y < height)

name: IsCellAboveWater
source: lane DD: 0x4affc0: all four corners >= waterLevel

name: AsPersistResource
source: lane DD: shared 0x1f9910: this + 4 or null; Save passes it to SaveResource

name: RaiseRect
source: lane DD: 0x4b0620: SetHeightAt(h + delta, 1) over the rect, primary slot 6 InvalidateRect, post 0xac3a02d9 then 0x0fb96150

name: SetRectHeight
source: lane DD: 0x4b0150: as RaiseRect with a fixed height

name: IsInWorld
source: lane DD: 0x4b00a0: 0 <= x <= worldSizeX and 0 <= z <= worldSizeY
